2. From Nadia: An approved work arrangement means meetings cannot start before 10:00 AM, and agenda materials must be circulated at least 48 hours in advance. This affects our meeting scheduling and notice requirements.

3. From Theo (People Operations): The merged team falls under a people-process procedure requiring a neutral facilitator and exactly two documented checkpoint meetings within the first 30 days. This must be incorporated into the charter.

These are all relevant constraints and process requirements that I'll ensure are integrated into the finalized charter. Before I proceed to sign-off, does anyone have additional commitments, constraints, or process requirements to state? If not, I'll work these into the charter and then publish the approved version to the merged team as part of the normal sign-off process.
